alt: The night market quarter at 20:30: Rico walks the warm festival paving between ten stalls with striped awnings — tacos, ramen, dumplings, sweets, juice, barbecue, noodles, coffee, flowers and books — paper lanterns swaying from the string lights over a crowd of browsers gathered for the band's set, and the festival stage at the north end with its red curtain and a three-piece band bobbing to the beat under a MERCADO sign
name: 1-market.jpg

alt: A four-star night chase in downtown Solmar: Rico's car bears down on a spike strip laid across the road ahead — a dark band with bright steel teeth, still unfolding, with reflective chevrons painted on the asphalt ahead of it — with a police roadblock of two cruisers parked sideways behind it, light bars flashing, and three more patrol cars strung out in pursuit behind him through the neon-lit streets
name: 2-spikes.jpg

alt: A three-star police chase through downtown Solmar at night in a thunderstorm: a forked lightning bolt splits the sky over the towers with a second branch reaching the ground, the whole street washes white with the flash, and behind the fleeing car three patrol cars with flashing light bars chase through rain-slicked streets where the neon burns twice as bright, their headlight cones stretched long on the wet asphalt
name: 3-storm.jpg

alt: Golden hour over the new airfield on the north edge: the prop plane lifts off the runway, its shadow still on the asphalt below, with the hangar and its AIRFIELD sign behind it, the painted runway markings and amber edge lights, white approach strobes, a windsock leaning in the breeze and fuel drums by the hangar, and Rico waiting in a car on the north road below
name: 4-airport.jpg
